comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. Checked 2026-10-21 against Winter Park's own winter trail map 2025-26 (the resort's PDF). The map's Extreme Terrain (EX) runs are tagged expert here, like the Cirque's chutes in OSM. Halfpipe and the snow_park runs (Railyard, Re-Railer, Ambush) are parks in OSM already. Lifts that are not Winter Park's are hidden: the tubing hill's carpet and four unnamed surface lifts at a tubing hill in Fraser, north of the box. Wildwood Glade's two outlines, closed ways without area=yes that would draw as dashed blue loops, are hidden until OpenStreetMap marks them as areas (review of 2026-10-22).

Wildwood Glade, the smaller of its two outlines: a closed way tagged natural=wood, gladed=yes and piste:type=downhill without area=yes, so the pipeline would draw the glade's outline as an 870 m dashed blue loop and rank it with the intermediate trunk runs (bold at z11-12 below Lunch Rock). The resort's 2025-26 map shows WILDWOOD GLADE as a labelled glade zone between Edelweiss and the Sunnyside Express, with no run line. Hidden until OpenStreetMap tags it area=yes; this expect then stops the build, and the entry goes (review of 2026-10-22).
